Could not find compatible versions

Because g3 >= 1.0, < 2 could not be found in rubygems repository @SOURCE@/ or installed locally for any resolution platforms (x86_64-linux)
  and every version of g2 depends on g3 < 2,
  every version of g2 requires g3 < 1.0.
And because g0 >= 2.1.rc1 depends on g2 >= 1.0
  and g0 >= 2.1.rc1 depends on g3 >= 1.0,
  g0 >= 2.1.rc1 cannot be used.
Because g0 < 2.1.rc1 depends on g1 >= 1.0
  and g1 >= 1.0 could not be found in rubygems repository @SOURCE@/ or installed locally,
  g0 < 2.1.rc1 cannot be used.
Thus, version solving has failed.
